rows.text: Dear Perplexity team,
I am writing to apply for the Machine Learning Research Engineer internship at Perplexity.
rows.reason: Names position, no claim about applicant.

rows.text: In my Pneumonia X‑Ray Classifier project I fine‑tuned a pretrained ResNet18 on about 5,800 chest X‑ray images.
The model reached a recall of 0.93 on the held‑out test set.
For the Support Ticket Classifier I trained a TF‑IDF and logistic regression model on 20,000 labeled tickets and served it through a FastAPI endpoint in a Docker container.
My Chat With Your Docs project measured retrieval hit rate on a hand‑written question set and compared two embedding models on answer quality and memory use.
As a Working Student at Example Retail GmbH I built Python ETL scripts that load weekly sales data into PostgreSQL and automated a weekly sales report that the team previously built by hand.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to contributing to Perplexity’s search research.
Sincerely, Alex Example

rows.text: Thank you for considering my application; I look forward to contributing to Perplexity’s research efforts.
Sincerely, Jonas Beispiel
